## The problem

Cumulative review before the term-end exam is usually passive and low-engagement.

## Approach

Streamlit quiz that pays out salary cap and sends results to Google Sheets through st.secrets; players' OBP/SLG/ERA map to dice probability tables; scouting built on expected bases per plate appearance (law of total expectation).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Why it matters for a decision

Turns probability tables and expected value into resource-allocation decisions under a budget, which parallels analytic tradeoffs.
:::

Every result above is traced to a script, log, or artifact in the repository. See [How I Check My Work](/approach.qmd).

## Limitations

- Q16 uses causal wording for a regression slope
- 25 vs 30 question-count and cap-arithmetic inconsistencies
- Needs Google service account to run submissions

## Tools

Python, Streamlit, pandas, gspread
